title: SKF_AUDIT_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-audit-skill emits when {headless_mode} is true, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_AUDIT_RESULT_JSON: ': once on stdout when step 6 (report) finishes, before it chains to the health check, and once on stderr at every HARD HALT (status error). The shared emitter, skf-emit-result-envelope.py, builds every line from the payload a stage stages in the run folder, folds in the auto-decisions and warnings the run recorded there, derives exit_code from halt_reason, stamps run_id and result_path, writes the result files on success, and checks the line against this schema, so the model never types it. The skill's references/headless-contract.md holds the exit-code table and its stage files show the halt command.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when step 6 wrote the drift report and its result contract. 'error' on any HARD HALT.

skill_name.description: The audited skill. Null when the run halted before one was named (input-missing).

drift_score.description: The drift_score skf-severity-classify.py saved in step 5's severity.json. Null when the run halted before severity classification.

report_path.description: The drift report, drift-report-<timestamp>.md in the audited version's forge folder. Null when the run halted before step 1 wrote it, or when the report write failed.

next_workflow.description: 'update-skill' when the classification counts a CRITICAL or HIGH finding, or when upstream_moved is true (the skill is built from an older ref than the remote now names), so a maintain pipeline reaches update-skill after an upstream release; null otherwise and on a halt.

audit_ref.description: The ref the audit read: the baseline ref when it stayed on the baseline, the upstream ref when step 1's upstream-drift gate chose [C] and the run read that ref from a private source tree. Null before step 1 decided it.

upstream_moved.description: True when step 1's one skf-check-workspace-drift.py upstream call found that the remote moved past the commit and ref the skill was built from (status moved), false when it found them unchanged, null when the check was skipped (no git source, no baseline commit or ref, a stack skill, a docs-only skill) or could not reach the remote.

upstream_ref.description: When upstream_moved is true, the ref the remote moved to (the newer tag, the moved tag or branch, or 'HEAD' for the default branch): pass it to update-skill as --target-ref. Null otherwise.

exit_code.description: Process exit code matching the Exit Codes table of the skill's references/headless-contract.md, derived from halt_reason: null gives 0, input-missing 2, skill-not-found, not-skf-output, forge-tier-missing, no-baseline, source-dir-missing, provenance-invalid, source-unreadable and helper-missing 3, write-failed 4, user-cancelled 6.

halt_reason.description: Null on success. One of the documented HALT classes on error, so a pipeline branches on the failure class without parsing the prose message.

run_id.description: The run's id, stamped by the emitter from the run folder name: the run's timestamp (YYYYMMDD-HHmmss), the stamp the drift report's file name carries. Null for a halt before the run folder exists.

result_path.description: The per-run result file the emitter wrote in the audited version's forge folder, audit-skill-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json (UTC), beside its audit-skill-result-latest.json copy. Stamped by the emitter, never typed. Null on every halt, which writes no result file, and when the write failed (warnings say why).

gate.description: The gate that auto-resolved: step 1's manifest-vs-link gate, its upstream-drift gate, or its baseline confirm gate (init.baseline-confirm), which a run reaches only on a baseline doubt: the forge tier below the compile tier, or a provenance map more than 90 days old. Each records its decision in the run sink the moment it decides.

default_action.description: The action documented as the gate's default: 'N' (audit the link's version) or 'C' (audit the upstream ref, or continue past the baseline doubt).

taken_action.description: The action the run took: the default, or the pre-supplied upstream_drift_choice ('C', 'S' or 'X').

reason.description: Human-readable rationale, such as 'headless: upstream moved v1.2.0 -> v1.3.0; auditing v1.3.0'.

evidence.description: Optional gate-specific data, such as the baseline and upstream refs.

headless_decisions.description: Optional. One entry per gate that auto-resolved during the run, read from the run sink, so a halt reports the decisions taken before it. Present only when there is at least one.

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies the run recorded in its sink or the emitter raised, one string each, starting with its code: upstream_tree_unavailable when [C] could not read the upstream ref into a private tree and the audit stayed on the baseline, source_tree_not_removed when the private tree could not be removed, recipe_runner_failed (with the recipe runner's error line) when the runner left no JSON and named an error on stderr, so re-index extracted without it, doc_fetch_failed and doc_not_hashed (each with its count) when a docs-only skill's score leaves out documents that could not be fetched or have no recorded hash, customization_resolver_unavailable when the customization resolver failed and only the bundled customize.toml applied, and result_file_write_failed when a result file could not be written. Present only when there is at least one.

phase.description: Where the run halted: the step and gate, for example 'init:skill-path' or 'report:write'.

reason.description: The halt message the step displayed, on one line.

path.description: Optional path the failed operation targeted.

error.description: Present on a HARD HALT only: where the run stopped and why. Pipelines branch on halt_reason and read error for the diagnostic.
